## Guardrails, handoff and stopping rule

- [ ] No unauthorized change to default Canvas+FFmpeg, schema, new packages/licenses, external media, model/provider, M11/M12 freeze, other video repositories or private/company/NAS/Drive data.
- [ ] Checked [tool and license map](../blob/main/docs/RECOVERED-TOOL-AND-LICENSE-MAP-2026-10-11.md) if evaluating/adopting any outside component; if no external component, mark N/A in notes.
- [ ] Compared against prior Draft candidate #9 (director), #20 (brief reuse), #23 (template registry), #29 (QA) **when relevant**, without automatically merging them.
- [ ] Reviewed actual diff, exact-head CI, live main and PR gates before requesting merge; creative quality != CI green.
- [ ] Recorded remaining blockers and next responsible owner decision in PR/Issue and updated canonical handoff for any changed decisions.
